record.paper_title: Open questions for strongly interacting Fermi gases with zero-range interactions
record.original_question: What is the large-order asymptotic behavior of the cluster coefficients b_{n↑,n↓} as n↑ and n↓ tend to infinity in the fugacity expansion of the homogeneous strongly interacting two-component Fermi gas, and how can those asymptotics be used to resum the cluster series efficiently enough to reach the degenerate regime T ≲ TF?

artifact.category_tag: Fugacity/cluster expansion for unitary Fermi gas
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider a homogeneous two-component Fermi gas in three dimensions with spin states σ ∈ {↑, ↓}, interacting via a zero-range (contact) interaction tuned to the unitary limit (infinite s-wave scattering length, zero range). Let the system be in thermal equilibrium at temperature T (with β = 1/(k_B T)), chemical potentials μ_↑ = μ_↓ = μ, and thermal de Broglie wavelength λ_T = (2π ℏ²β / m)^{1/2}. Introduce fugacities z_σ = e^{βμ_σ}. The grand-canonical pressure admits the virial (fugacity) expansion

   P(μ,T) / (k_B T) = λ_T^{-3} ∑_{n_↑, n_↓ ≥ 0, (n_↑,n_↓)≠(0,0)} b_{n_↑, n_↓} z_↑^{n_↑} z_↓^{n_↓},

where b_{n_↑, n_↓} are the dimensionless cluster (virial) coefficients of the homogeneous unitary Fermi gas, defined from the cluster expansion of the grand-canonical partition function and given as connected N=n_↑+n_↓-particle integrals over the Boltzmann operator at unitarity.

Denote by T_F the Fermi temperature corresponding to a chosen total density.

(a) Determine the large-order asymptotic behavior of the coefficients b_{n_↑, n_↓} as n_↑, n_↓ → ∞ (in particular, the leading exponential and sub-exponential factors as functions of n_↑ and n_↓, including the balanced case n_↑ = n_↓ → ∞).

(b) Using the asymptotics obtained in (a), construct a resummation of the fugacity series above that converges (or is Borel/Padé/conformally summable) for fugacities corresponding to the degenerate regime T ≲ T_F, and quantify the rate of convergence.
artifact.status_search_result: The large-order asymptotics of the unitary-gas cluster coefficients b_{n_↑,n_↓} and a resummation reaching the degenerate regime T ≲ T_F appear to remain open. Only the first several virial coefficients (up to roughly b_4 or b_5, and some partial higher-order numerical results) are known, and current resummations (Padé, Borel, conformal mapping) extend the virial series only modestly below T_F. No published result establishes the full large-n asymptotics or a controlled resummation valid throughout the degenerate regime.

status_evidence.title: Virial expansion for the unitary Fermi gas (review literature)
status_evidence.snippet: Only the first few virial coefficients of the unitary Fermi gas are known; resummation techniques extend their applicability only slightly below the Fermi temperature.
status_evidence.claim: Existing computations of cluster coefficients are limited to low orders, and no large-order asymptotic formula is established.
